selection.selection_reason: Select the prespecified 200-patient E1, complete 30-script x 5 E2 with corrected source-consistent backgrounds and exact unknown fallback, supplemental E1 of those E2 outputs, all three complete E3 configurations, the completed mock load sequence, and all prespecified small real-load levels. Earlier E2 runs remain excluded for documented integrity defects, not performance.
selection.excluded_runs_policy: All recovered runs remain inventoried in asset_provenance.json; smoke runs are not pooled into the formal cohort.
selection.load_caveat: Mock E4 used the backend before the final structured-writeback branch guard. Real E4 uses the final guard and a small AP-01 replay workload on indexed synthetic patients. Modes differ in workload and code revision; they are descriptive local load observations, not matched comparisons or national capacity estimates.

excluded_runs.experiments/results/e2_end_to_end/202610: Interrupted107/150 pilot; original background contradictions and initial overlap with mock load.
Corrected backgrounds but defective substring-based unknown fallback could assert a symptom; preserved and excluded in favor of a full rerun after the deterministic fix.

interop_cohorts.policy: e1.templated_batch + e1_e2.from_runs; primary imports and secondary templates excluded to prevent duplicate cohort counts

note: Provisional tables are not clinical validation. Validated table filters current hashes.
